trust_decision.summary: Whether the spec URL may be fetched (internal/loopback/private targets, redirects) is decided by mcp-from-openapi's SSRF guard on the initial fromURL() load, but the poller's timed re-fetch calls raw fetch() with no guard.

landing_point.why: The summary names the spec-change poller; its doFetch() holds the only raw fetch of the spec URL.

fix_sites.entry_point: OpenapiAdapter polling (startPolling) and the exported OpenApiSpecPoller.poll()/start() (libs/adapters/src/openapi/index.ts:14)
fix_sites.module_kind: core fetch path in the poller (raw fetch replaced by safeFetch)
defaults: block-internal SSRF policy and followRedirects=false when the caller passes none (fix.diff:292-293)
options type: adds ssrf and followRedirects (fix.diff:394-399)
wrapper/merge route: carries loadOptions.refResolution and loadOptions.followRedirects into the poller (fix.diff:418-425)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: libs/adapters/src/openapi/openapi.adapter.ts:917 (pinned) / fix.diff:418-425: the adapter must merge its loadOptions.refResolution and followRedirects policy into the polling options; the standalone poller must default to blocking (fix.diff:292)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who guards the poller's fetch could argue the adapter wiring is not needed because the adapter's initial fromURL() load is already guarded, or that the standalone exported poller is a low-level utility whose caller owns URL trust.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Polling a localhost/internal spec server must keep working when the operator opts in via loadOptions.refResolution.allowInternalIPs: true, and ETag/If-Modified-Since conditional polling with 304 handling must keep working; a hard-coded block or a poller that ignores the adapter's policy breaks these (the fix had to add allowInternalIPs to 8 existing e2e tests, fix.diff:109-165).

O6_input_shapes: literal loopback/private IP in the spec URL
DNS name that resolves to an internal IP (resolved-IP check in safeFetch)
3xx redirect to an internal target (followRedirects default false, hops re-validated)
allowedHosts / blockedHosts lists inherited from refResolution

O7_producer.where: libs/adapters/src/openapi/openapi.adapter.ts:223-225 (resolveRefResolution builds the SSRF policy from loadOptions); pinned startPolling at libs/adapters/src/openapi/openapi.adapter.ts:917 passes only options.polling

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A manual refresh/refetch method on the adapter (e.g. a public refreshSpec()) that does its own HEAD/GET of options.url for change detection before rebuilding
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The adapter already has a rebuild path triggered by the poller; a maintainer adding on-demand refresh for runtimes without timers (as saas-pull.source.ts:125 does) would plausibly reuse raw fetch.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A polled pull source that also re-fetches an OpenAPI spec URL alongside the overlay through its raw httpGet
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second polling implementation in the same package with its own raw fetch and timeout helper, separate from the openapi poller.

O9_family: SSRF (CWE-918): unguarded re-fetch of a configured/attacker-influenceable URL on a timer
